title: Docs site generator for an old template format
scenario: Archived-only candidates: the repositories that match are archived, so the eligibility policy must exclude or flag them.
idea: I have hundreds of documentation pages in an old template format nobody maintains anymore. I need a tool that builds them into a static website.

brief.problem: Existing documentation written in an unmaintained template format must still be built into a static website.
brief.users: A maintainer of a long-lived documentation set.

must_have.text: Build the existing pages into static HTML without rewriting them
Run from the command line as part of a build

constraints.deployment: Static files on any web host

assumptions.text: Migrating the pages to a modern format is out of scope
assumptions.reason: The idea asks to build them as they are

unknowns: The exact name and version of the old template format
